Piecewise Exponential Survival Time for Multiple Treatment Arms

Source: R/class_time_piecewise_survival_multigroup.R
PiecewiseSurvivalTimeMultiArm.Rd

Class for piecewise exponential survival times in patient-wise multi-arm simulations, with a common control hazard for all active treatment arms.

Details

Create objects with getPiecewiseSurvivalTimeMultiArm(). The class inherits from PiecewiseSurvivalTimeMultiGroup and TimeDefinition. Rows of lambdaControls repeat the common control hazards for each active arm. The dimensions of hazardRatio and medianTreatments are active arm, interval, and situation, in that order. Interval starts begin at zero and the last interval is open-ended. Supplied interval medians parameterize exponential hazards through log(2) / median; they are not the medians of the complete piecewise survival distributions. Derived hazards and hazard ratios are retained alongside the supplied medians.

Fields

piecewiseSurvivalTime

The time intervals for the piecewise definition of the exponential survival time cumulative distribution function. Is a numeric vector.

lambdaControl

The common control hazards for all active treatment arms, with one positive, finite value per piecewise survival interval. Is a numeric vector.

lambdaControls

Positive, finite control hazards, with groups in rows and piecewise survival intervals in columns. Groups are active treatment arms sharing the same control hazards in multi-arm specifications, or disjoint population subsets in enrichment specifications. Is a numeric matrix.

hazardRatio

Positive, finite treatment-to-control hazard ratios in a group-by-interval-by-situation numeric array. Groups are active treatment arms or disjoint population subsets. Situations occupy the third, slowest-changing dimension. Values are supplied directly or derived from the supplied interval medians.

medianControl

The supplied positive, finite exponential control medians, one per interval and common to all active arms, or NULL when control hazards were supplied directly. These parameterize interval hazards as log(2) / medianControl, rather than the median of the complete piecewise survival distribution.

medianTreatments

The supplied positive, finite exponential treatment medians in a group-by-interval-by-situation numeric array, or NULL when hazard ratios were supplied directly. Dimensions and names match hazardRatio. These parameterize interval treatment hazards, rather than the medians of the complete piecewise survival distributions.

groupType

The statistical role of the groups: "multi-arm" for active treatment arms sharing a common control, or "enrichment" for disjoint population subsets. Is a single character value.

See also

getPiecewiseSurvivalTimeMultiArm(), PiecewiseSurvivalTimeEnrichment
